CI compiles and tests this branch against an install whose top-level ajv
is 6.15.0 (main's hoisted eslint copy): ajv 6's export= typings make the
named Ajv import type-only (TS2693 at the constructor) and its errors
carry dataPath with no instancePath, so the wrong-type rejection lost the
field name and the orchestration suites' coverage collapsed. Import Ajv
as the default behind a local constructor shape and render
instancePath ?? dataPath, so either installed major compiles and names
the failing path.
